✔ Releases muscle tightness and reduces stiffness

This professional stretch technique is ideal for athletes, active individuals, and anyone struggling with tight, sore muscles or limited flexibility.

Glucosamine is a natural compound found in cartilage that helps maintain joint health and reduce inflammation. By incorporating a glucosamine-infused massage cream, we deliver targeted relief directly to problem areas.

blocks.html: Frequently Ask Questions

What is the Muscle & Joint Vitality Massage?

The Muscle & Joint Vitality Massage is a unique therapy that combines massage with Infrar-ray Therapy, Glucosamine cream application, and Professional Stretching to provide deep relief for sore muscles, stiff joints, and tension. It’s designed to go beyond traditional massage, offering a holistic approach to recovery and relaxation.

How does infrared therapy work?

Infrared therapy uses gentle, penetrating heat to warm up your body and increase circulation which oxygenates and nourishes muscles and joints, helping relieve soreness and pain. It breaks down metabolic toxins like Lactic Acid and other impurities helping to alleviate stiffness. Infrared heat therapy is especially beneficial for those experiencing chronic pain, arthritis, muscle tension, or circulation issues.

What are the benefits of Glucosamine cream?

Glucosamine cream is applied to nourish and repair joints. When used after Infrared Therapy, your pores are dilated, allowing for better absorption. The cream helps reduce stiffness, improve joint flexibility, and support long-term joint health.

Is Professional Stretching painful?

Not at all! Our stretching techniques are tailored to your comfort level and are performed on muscles that have been warmed up by Infrared Therapy. This makes the stretches more effective and comfortable, helping you achieve a greater range of motion without pain.

Who is this massage for?

This massage is perfect for:

  • Athletes looking to recover faster and improve performance.
  • Desk workers dealing with stiffness, poor posture, and tension from sitting all day.
  • Anyone experiencing muscle soreness, joint stiffness, or limited mobility.
How long does a session last?

A typical session lasts 60-90 minutes, depending on your needs and preferences. We recommend discussing your goals with your therapist to customize the session length.

How often should I get this massage?

For best results, we recommend:
Athletes: 1-2 times per week, especially after intense training or competitions.
Desk workers: Once every 1-2 weeks to maintain flexibility and reduce tension.
General wellness: Once a month for ongoing maintenance and relaxation.

Is this massage safe for people with chronic pain or injuries?

Yes, our massage is designed to be safe and effective for individuals with chronic pain or injuries. However, we recommend consulting with your therapist beforehand to ensure the techniques are tailored to your specific condition.

What should I wear during the session?

We provide disposable garments for your session. Your therapist will ensure you’re comfortable and modest throughout the session.

Can I combine this massage with other treatments?

Absolutely! This massage complements other therapies like physical therapy, chiropractic care, or acupuncture. Let your therapist know about any ongoing treatments so they can tailor your session accordingly.

Are there any side effects?

Most clients experience only positive effects, such as reduced pain, improved flexibility, and relaxation. Some may feel slight soreness after stretching, similar to the feeling after a good workout, but this typically subsides within a day.

How do I prepare for my session?
  • Hydrate well before your appointment.
  • Avoid heavy meals 1-2 hours before your session.
  • Arrive 15 minutes early to relax and fill out any necessary forms.
Can I book this massage as a gift for someone else?

Yes! Our Muscle & Joint Vitality Massage makes a thoughtful and rejuvenating gift. We offer gift cards that can be purchased online or in-person.
